name: Come With Me
source:
"Is happiness a choice, or a privilege reserved for the brave?"

In 1963, Lucas spends his days in a small town where little ever seems to change. He wakes before sunrise to open the bakery, looks after his family, and carries on with the same routine he has followed for years. It is a simple life, one he has long accepted as his own. 

Everything begins to shift when Gaston, a childhood friend who once vanished beyond the town’s borders, returns without warning. His arrival stirs memories Lucas thought had faded and awakens feelings he has kept buried for far too long. As the days pass, Lucas finds himself caught between the life he has always known and the possibility of something more.

Come With Me is a short SFW furry visual novel about love, family, and the struggle between duty and happiness.

[From [url=https://shine-lwp.itch.io/come-with-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“幸福是一种选择，还是勇敢者的特权？”

1963年，卢卡斯在一个小镇上度过了他的日子，那里似乎从未发生过任何变化。他在日出前醒来，开面包店，照顾家人，并继续他多年来遵循的惯例。这是一种简单的生活，他早已接受了这种生活。

当曾经消失在小镇边界之外的儿时好友加斯顿毫无征兆地回归时，一切都开始发生变化。他的到来激起了卢卡斯本以为已经褪色的记忆，并唤醒了他埋藏太久的感情。随着日子一天天过去，卢卡斯发现自己陷入了自己熟悉的生活和更多生活的可能性之间。

《跟我来》是一部关于爱情、家庭以及责任与幸福之间的斗争的短篇《SFW》毛茸茸视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://shine-lwp.itch.io/come-with-me]Itch.io[/url]]
